prospective_amendments.trigger: A DGX package-install engineering attempt established that upstream TextWorld 1.7.0 invokes Inform7 setup and its official archive has no aarch64 compiler payload. The attempt stopped during dependency construction.
prospective_amendments.change: Preserve the historically qualified runtime bytes; move valid_unseen-opaque lookup into a B0-only source; install the exact official TextWorld 1.7.0 revision with an explicit PDDL-only build adapter that skips Inform7 setup and supplies no Inform7 capability.

canonical_role: A bounded no-learning calibration of one locally authorized sealed ALFWorld text task family. It estimates baseline task headroom, execution burden, and official valid_seen sensitivity before any B2, H1, canonical revision, or G1 occurrence.
research_question: Can a frozen frontier-model, no-learning actor achieve non-floor and non-saturated success on a clean text-only ALFWorld family under a sealed 20-action environment horizon, while the instrument records every scheduled episode without hidden repair?

arm.within_episode_context: The current request may contain only the ordered visible observation/action transcript from the same episode plus the current visible observation.
forbidden: expert plans, hidden PDDL, admissible-command lists, or outcome fields
credit, revision proposal, canonical state mutation, owner decision, Permit, admission, remove, or restore
human repair, manual action substitution, retry, replacement, or refill

valid_unseen_zero_touch: no individual UID or path decoding by the selector
no prompt authoring, dry run, model call, outcome inspection, threshold tuning, transcript review, or error taxonomy
no adaptive allocation after train or valid_seen outcomes
prospective_selection.public_projection: Aggregate counts and commitments only; individual game and task-group identities remain in a non-repository private receipt.
prospective_selection.execution_order: All eight selected train games in committed rank order, then all four selected valid_seen games in committed rank order. No outcome-dependent reordering.

actor_contract.system_prompt_utf8: You control one ALFWorld text game. Using only the current episode transcript and current observation, return exactly one JSON object whose action value is the next literal environment command. Do not output reasoning, commentary, multiple commands, tools, memories, lessons, outcomes, admissible-command lists, or state changes.
actor_contract.action_post_schema: Printable ASCII bytes 0x20 through 0x7e only; 1 through 512 bytes; no CR, LF, explanation, or multiple-command repair.
actor_contract.response_json_whitespace_policy: Parse one strict JSON object with duplicate keys forbidden; insignificant JSON whitespace is accepted and is not treated as provider-byte exactness.
actor_contract.token_preflight: Required before every completion; prompt tokens plus 64 must not exceed 32768.
actor_contract.issued_post_gate: A fresh occurrence-local gate consumes one tokenize or completion allowance immediately before each transport attempt, including failed attempts; it refuses the 241st request of either kind before network dispatch.
actor_contract.episode_context_disposal: Erase the in-memory transcript after each terminal or invalid episode; never supply it to another episode.

install_order: install patched TextWorld with TEXTWORLD_PDDL_ONLY=1 and --no-deps
supply HSWM from the clean execution checkout through PYTHONPATH

model_runtime.sampling_note: Greedy decoding is retained from the already measured DGX deployment to reduce one source of noise. Provider-byte equality is not a prerequisite or evidence of learning.

resource_and_stopping_contract.ordinary_episode_terminal: A simulator terminal before or at action 20 consumes the episode and advances to the next committed episode.
resource_and_stopping_contract.failure_rule: Any asset, sandbox, model-service, token-preflight, response-schema, action-grammar, outcome-receipt, source-binding, or request-counter failure seals the exact attempted prefix, forbids retry or resume, and terminates the occurrence as INCONCLUSIVE_MEASUREMENT_NOT_READY.
resource_and_stopping_contract.all_run_manifest: The private receipt records every attempted selected episode, including negative, timeout, invalid, or incomplete outcomes.

estimands_and_decisions.primary_train_estimand: Simulator success count out of exactly eight selected train task groups.
estimands_and_decisions.valid_seen_estimand: Simulator success count out of exactly four selected valid_seen groups, descriptive only.
secondary: actions, tokenize calls, completion calls, prompt tokens, completion tokens, and wall time
invalid episode fraction and exact failure class
estimands_and_decisions.uncertainty: Report two-sided 95 percent Clopper-Pearson intervals for complete split counts; no hypothesis test or multiplicity claim.
estimands_and_decisions.valid_seen_interpretation: Descriptive contamination and official-split sensitivity only. Similarity to train is not lineage-independence evidence; a difference cannot be attributed uniquely to contamination.

measurement_integrity_boundary.known_null: The exact fixed-look sealed runtime qualification terminated with won=false and score=0.
measurement_integrity_boundary.outcome_provenance: Simulator terminal outcome on a local OS process boundary, hidden from the actor but not independently owned or externally authenticated.
measurement_integrity_boundary.pretraining_exposure: Unknown and uncontrolled; ALFWorld may be represented in model pretraining.
measurement_integrity_boundary.consequence: This occurrence cannot pass G0 even if complete and cannot unlock G1. It only decides whether this task/model surface has usable exploratory headroom and exposes instrument faults.

control_mapping.CF-01: Model, runtime, prompt, action, context, call, token, environment, and wall-time budgets are fixed for the sole B0 arm and ready for later matched-arm inheritance.
control_mapping.CF-07: NOT_SATISFIED: the simulator outcome is actor-hidden but locally co-owned; no independent evaluator or evaluator swap exists.
control_mapping.CF-08: Static prompt and all request/token/time/action counts are recorded; retries, human repair, and per-task adaptation are forbidden.
control_mapping.CF-09: Strict actor/outcome schemas and the fixed-action null are present; an independent known-answer live calibration is still absent.
control_mapping.CF-13: Prospective task-group selection, no replacement, zero valid_unseen use, exact-prefix sealing, and aggregate/private projection separation are fixed.

no_claim: B0 has no learning, lesson, retrieval update, canonical revision, causal credit, owner-valid Permit admission, or HSWM causal variable.
A B0 score is not an ALFWorld reproduction, ExpeL replication, model ranking, G0 passage, G1 occurrence, FCL-1 evidence, or HSWM efficacy result.
valid_seen is contamination-sensitive because 25 of 27 groups overlap train; it is not a lineage-disjoint holdout.
valid_unseen remains untouched and cannot be inspected or used to tune this calibration.
The local sandbox and simulator outcome are bounded engineering interfaces, not independently owned cognition or proof of outcome independence.
This study does not alter HSWM's SCIENTIFICALLY_CONNECTED / INTEGRATED_CLAIM_UNJUDGED status and makes no consciousness, selfhood, HSWM-of-HSWMs, or scale-invariant causal-closure claim.
